verdict.rationale: Vercel ships multiple natural-language control surfaces for AI-native users: the built-in Vercel Agent chat (dashboard/Slack) for investigating issues and taking approved actions, an official OAuth-gated MCP server exposing deploy/observability/domain tools to any approved AI client, and an agent playbook instructing agents to 'act, not paraphrase' when performing Vercel operations. These are first-party documented and probe-confirmed live endpoints (mcp.vercel.com, ai-catalog.json). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that these NL flows work reliably in practice, and several capabilities (Vercel Agent chat, some MCP client access) are gated to beta/Pro+Enterprise or an approved-client allowlist rather than universally available.
